title: Marie in Motion
author: Mariexu
description: Marie in Motion is a podcast about movement—through places, experiences, and ideas. I share my own travel stories and reflections, but also invite guests: fellow travelers searching for meaning on the road and locals who deeply love their home, offering a different perspective on belonging. Together, we explore identity, life choices, and what it truly means to feel at home in the world. Whether you're always on the move or deeply rooted in one place, this podcast is a space for reflection, discovery, and connection.
